newsitem.title: USA: Reynolds Metals to sell plant to Tredegar.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds Metals to sell plant to Tredegar.

text.p: Reynolds Metal Co said Friday it has signed a letter of intent to sell its aluminum extrusion plant in El Campo, Texas, to a subsidiary of Tredegar Industries Inc.
Terms of the sale were not disclosed.
The company said that subject to regulatory approval, a definitive agreement, and other customary closing conditions, the sale is expected to close by May 31.
The plant employs 233 people and generated about $45 million in sales in 1996.
Reynolds said the sale of the plant is part of its previously-announced review of all its plants and businesses, and it expects to announce a detailed overview of its plans in the first half of 1997.
